title: Two-process coupling characterization of weak convergence
exact_target: Can weak convergence of shifted processes be characterized by coupling just the original process and its limiting process?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9900007 (AMR-098-0007). CC BY 4.0.
